responsibility: This header declares the playback class hierarchy and APIs that materialize recorded libgccjit state as GCC trees during compilation. It defines playback::context operations for constructing types, functions, blocks, expressions, globals, asm, diagnostics, and locations, along with wrapper classes for function/block/rvalue/lvalue/source-file/source-line/location objects and the active_playback_ctxt singleton declaration. It is the main internal interface for the tree-building and replay phase, complementary to jit-recording.h.
same_name_distinction: Unlike gcc/jit/jit-playback.cc, which performs the actual lowering and compilation work, this same-stem header provides the internal declarations for playback::context and the wrapper classes used to represent functions, blocks, values, and source locations during replay.
